features.name: HTTP methods, headers, raw bodies
features.detail: Single requests and sequential steps share validated methods, headers, raw bodies, status codes, and timeouts.

features.name: HTTPS certificate handling
features.detail: Verified by default; explicit insecure option works locally and on workers. Custom workload CAs, client certificates, and TLS tuning are absent.

features.name: REST and SOAP payloads
features.detail: Raw HTTP can send JSON or XML. There are no schema, WSDL, or service-specific helpers.

features.name: Redirect handling
features.detail: Responses are returned without following redirects. Scoped redirect chains and per-hop metrics need implementation.

features.name: Multipart and file uploads
features.detail: Only inline string bodies are supported; file streaming and multipart construction are absent.

features.name: HTTP authentication managers
features.detail: Bearer and API-key headers and login journeys work. Basic helpers, Digest, NTLM, Kerberos, and managed credentials are absent.

features.name: Cookies and session lifecycle
features.detail: Bounded per-user journey jars persist across users-mode iterations; rate journeys get fresh jars. No configurable cookie policies or single-request session jar.

features.name: Cache and DNS policies
features.detail: Go transport DNS and connection reuse apply. Browser cache simulation, host overrides, and selectable DNS policies are absent.

features.name: Proxy and connection controls
features.detail: Environment proxies and pooled HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2 work. Per-test proxy, source address, embedded resources, and bandwidth controls are absent.

features.name: FTP
features.detail: No file-transfer sampler or connection configuration.

features.name: JDBC and SQL databases
features.detail: No query sampler, transaction isolation, parameter binding, or connection pool. JVM bridge required for arbitrary JDBC drivers.

features.name: LDAP and extended directory operations
features.detail: No directory bind, search, compare, add, modify, delete, or session adapter.

features.name: JMS publish, subscribe, and request/reply
features.detail: No JMS provider or JNDI integration. A JVM bridge is needed for provider compatibility.

features.name: SMTP, POP3, IMAP and secure variants
features.detail: No mail send/read or attachment verification.

features.name: TCP and pluggable framing
features.detail: No raw socket sampler, framing codec, or connection-lifecycle controls.

features.name: Java objects and JUnit
features.detail: No Java execution adapter or JUnit runtime. Native Go extensions alone would not provide Java compatibility.

features.name: OS process execution
features.detail: No process sampler, exit-status assertion, or bounded stdout/stderr collection.

features.name: Bolt database protocol
features.detail: No Bolt adapter or connection configuration.

features.name: Deprecated MongoDB components
features.detail: No legacy MongoDB scripting/source components. Decide legacy bridge support before claiming strict historical coverage.

features.name: Concurrent users and thread lifecycle
features.detail: Fixed users repeat for a duration, a finite number of iterations per user, or whichever limit comes first. User ramps and startup delay are supported, with sampled active-user counts. Users can continue, start the next iteration, stop one user, or stop the test gracefully/immediately. No independent thread groups or distributed users.

features.name: Open workload model
features.detail: Constant or seeded stratified jitter arrivals with explicit drops and a concurrency cap. JMeter open-model expressions and Poisson arrivals are absent.

features.name: Traffic phases and recovery tests
features.detail: Sequential constant-rate phases, including zero-rate admission pauses; graphical phase editor.

features.name: Delay and throughput timers
features.detail: Fixed think time, per-step pauses, and arrival pacing. No Gaussian, uniform, Poisson, exact-throughput, or scriptable per-scope timer equivalents.

features.name: Synchronization and critical sections
features.detail: No rendezvous barriers or named cross-user critical sections.

features.name: Setup, teardown and reusable fragments
features.detail: No setup/teardown groups, modules, includes, or reusable test fragments.

features.name: Sequential and weighted flows
features.detail: Ordered fail-fast steps and deterministic weighted scenario selection. No nested transaction controllers or arbitrary step containers.

features.name: Loops, once-only and foreach
features.detail: Nested fixed-count and bounded while loops with scoped iteration variables. Once-per-user blocks, foreach collections, and independent user-group loop counts remain absent.

features.name: If, while and switch
features.detail: Nested if/else and bounded while conditions use explicit string, numeric, and existence comparisons. Switch, compound expressions, and scripting remain absent.

features.name: Interleave, random and throughput controllers
features.detail: Weighted scenarios cover a limited selection use case; no random order, interleave, runtime, or percentage/execution-count controllers.

features.name: Flow actions and failure policies
features.detail: Users mode supports continue, next-iteration, stop-user and graceful/immediate test stops, preserving errors and partial results. Graceful drains other admitted journeys; JMX review explains the difference from sampler-level stopping. No programmable break/continue controllers, restart-user, or rate/distributed error policies.

features.name: Variables, counters and functions
features.detail: Scoped string variables, reserved user/iteration/journey IDs, and encoding filters. No general function library, mutable counters, shared properties, or expression engine.

features.name: CSV datasets and external files
features.detail: Native UTF-8 CSV import, column mapping, shared/per-user rows and recycle/normal stop-user EOF in local users-mode journeys. Source is embedded in saved scenarios. No rate/fleet CSV allocation, JMX CSV conversion, headerless files, alternate encodings or file functions.

features.name: Random data, time, UUID and transforms
features.detail: No general random-data, date arithmetic, UUID, digest, encoding, or mathematical function library. Arrival jitter is independent.

features.name: JSON extraction and querying
features.detail: RFC 6901 scalar pointers work. JSONPath and JMESPath selectors, multiple matches, and defaults are absent.

features.name: Regex and boundary extraction
features.detail: No regex captures, boundary matching, or match-selection rules.

features.name: CSS and XPath extraction
features.detail: No HTML selector, XML namespace, or XPath engine.

features.name: Response header extraction
features.detail: Extract a present first header value into a journey variable for later steps.

features.name: Preprocessors and postprocessors
features.detail: Templates and extraction are fixed built-in operations. No configurable processor chain, URL rewriting, link parsing, JDBC processors, or status handlers.

features.name: Response assertions
features.detail: Status lists, scalar JSON/header equality, and literal body substrings. No regex, negative match, boolean composition, or assertion scopes.

features.name: XML, HTML and JSON validation
features.detail: No XML/HTML parser validation, XPath predicates, XML schema, JSONPath, or JMESPath assertions.

features.name: Duration and size assertions
features.detail: Per-request/journey timeouts, body-size ceiling, and aggregate p95 checks. No independent per-sample duration/size assertion ranges.

features.name: Checksums, comparisons and S/MIME
features.detail: No MD5, response comparison, S/MIME, or scripted assertions.

features.name: Acceptance checks and CI exit status
features.detail: Request, whole-journey, and scenario thresholds affect pass/fail; CLI uses documented exit codes. No statistical regression claim.

features.name: Aggregates and percentiles
features.detail: Bounded merged histograms, per-phase/scenario/step counters, error categories, and latency distributions. No per-sample JTL population or configurable histogram precision.

features.name: Portable HTML and result exports
features.detail: Standalone HTML, aggregate JSON, and saved timeline bundles. No full JMeter chart set, APDEX, CSV/JTL exchange, or offline raw-sample reanalysis.

features.name: Request/response debugging and listeners
features.detail: No View Results Tree equivalent, bounded response samples, assertion tree, debug sampler, or processor inspection. Reports intentionally omit bodies and headers.

features.name: Streaming backend listeners
features.detail: No external result sink, Graphite/InfluxDB listener, or export plugin API. Prometheus target scraping is a separate feature.

features.name: Offline files and saved response output
features.detail: Saved aggregate runs can be imported and compared. No raw response files, CSV/XML result writers, or external JTL import.

features.name: Mail and custom event listeners
features.detail: No mail notifications or user-defined sample listeners.

features.name: Visual test creation and editing
features.detail: Request, header, body, phase, and threshold controls plus a journey canvas with nested branches, loops, scoped variables, dependencies, and observed control counts. No general component tree or recording.

features.name: HTTP(S) recording
features.detail: No recording proxy, capture filters, request grouping, certificate authority lifecycle, or recording controller.

features.name: Access-log replay
features.detail: No access-log parser, replay sampler, or replay filters.

features.name: Mirror server and property/debug inspectors
features.detail: No mirror server, property display, debug sampler, or debug postprocessor.

features.name: Element defaults and scope inheritance
features.detail: Top-level and per-step headers and statuses inherit through a fixed model. No arbitrary nested scopes, defaults managers, or independently reusable element configuration.

features.name: JMX plans, templates and migration
features.detail: Guided JMeter 5.6.3 JMX review, limited duration-based HTTP conversion, property inputs, original source retention, and non-runnable migration drafts. Broader component mappings, JMX export, and cross-engine conformance remain open.

features.name: Headless execution and configuration
features.detail: CLI, strict JSON, flag overrides, validation, reports, and cancellation. No full JMeter properties/remote CLI compatibility.

features.name: Distributed engines
features.detail: Authenticated rate-mode workers split a global schedule and merge histograms. No distributed users, shared files, automatic failover, or JMeter RMI interoperability.

features.name: JSR223, BeanShell and custom code
features.detail: No Groovy/BeanShell/JSR223 runtime or scripting hooks. A different language alone will not reproduce existing scripts.

features.name: Custom samplers, timers and visualizers
features.detail: No public plugin SDK, discovery, versioning, isolation, or Java-plugin adapter. Third-party plugin parity needs a named, versioned inventory.

features.name: Explicit missed-demand accounting
features.detail: Capacity and scheduler misses stay in planned-demand denominators; no catch-up burst or unbounded queue.

features.name: Fleet-wide arrival partitioning
features.detail: One total rate is partitioned over worker ordinals and fixed quotas rather than duplicating the full offered load per worker.

features.name: Target-server metric observation
features.detail: Opt-in selected Prometheus gauges/counters with coverage gaps, reset handling, and a bounded final observation independent of load checks.

features.name: Generator and transport diagnostics
features.detail: Process resources plus sampled HTTP timing and connection facts; timing populations and observation limits stay visible.

features.name: Local saved workspace and comparisons
features.detail: Local run/scenario library, portable bundles, live charts, and descriptive comparison that flags differing conditions.

features.name: WebSocket
features.detail: No persistent duplex socket sessions or message assertions. Not a bundled JMeter sampler in this baseline.

features.name: gRPC
features.detail: No protobuf descriptors, unary/streaming RPCs, or RPC-specific metrics. Not a bundled JMeter sampler in this baseline.

features.name: OpenTelemetry result export
features.detail: No OTLP result export or trace-context correlation.

features.name: Repeatable regression analysis
features.detail: Comparisons are descriptive; no statistical verdict, repeated-trial model, or CI baseline management.
